verdict.rationale:
Nix supports per-project reproducible dev environments via checked-in shell.nix/flake.nix files, using `nix-shell` or `nix develop` to build/enter a shell with pinned language runtimes and tool versions, and multiple versions can coexist without conflict. Community testimony confirms real-world use of `nix-shell --run` for reliable dependency management across projects.
missing for 10: explicit walkthrough of switching between multiple pinned toolchain versions across sibling projects, and no mention of direnv/auto-activation integration.
